title: NodeUpgrade
description: Update the daemon (architecture.md §14.3). The download URL is fixed: <console>/node/dist/agent-teams-node-<version>.tgz. The daemon checks sha256 (and the Ed25519 release signature when it has release.pub), installs the release next to the running one, drains its sessions, switches the current symlink and exits 75 for its launcher; progress comes back as node.upgrade_result.

version.description: Release id: <package version>+<build>, build = first 8 hex of sha256(node.mjs).

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature of the tgz; required only by daemons that have release.pub.

mode.description: wait_idle (default): switch once no turn is running; now: interrupt running turns; cancel: stop an update that has not switched yet.

deadline_s.description: wait_idle: report drain_timeout after this many seconds (keeps waiting). Default 1800.

min_node.description: Lowest Node.js major version the release runs on.
